speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms better, could you tell me how long you have been experiencing these changes in behavior and weight? Also, have you noticed any other physical changes, such as feeling unusually cold or having dry skin?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male. The patient has demonstrated inappropriate behavior, including making unfitting comments and attempts to kiss strangers, over the past 6 months. He shows disinterest in family interactions and has developed a particular craving for chocolate pudding and potato chips, resulting in a 10 kg weight gain. The patient also presents as unkempt.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any changes in his sense of smell or taste, and does he exhibit any memory loss or confusion? I also need to know if he has experienced any headaches, vision changes, or urinary incontinence.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inappropriate behavior. I also have Disinterest in family interactions, Craving for specific foods, Significant weight gain, Apathy, Blunted affect.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will now request imaging of the brain to look for frontal lobe pathology. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal MRI, I need to rule out metabolic causes like hypothyroidism which can cause weight gain and apathy. REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Function_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal imaging and thyroid results, I suspect a frontal lobe disorder like Frontotemporal Dementia. Have you noticed any changes in his judgment, problem-solving abilities, or language skills over these six months?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant medical history provided. Social history: No detailed social history provided; recent behavior includes attempting to initiate inappropriate physical contact with strangers.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the patient have any history of alcohol or substance abuse, and has there been any recent head trauma or significant life stressors? I also need to know if he has experienced any seizures or loss of consciousness during these episodes.

speaker: Patient
text: The patient avoids questions and instead comments on unrelated subjects. Shows apathy towards surroundings and interactions.

speaker: Doctor
text: His disinhibition, apathy, and specific hyperphagia (craving sweet/fatty foods) are classic signs of behavioral variant Frontotemporal Dementia, despite the normal structural MRI. DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia
